summary: First full E2E test for MAE Tornillería migration (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). 11/11 backend pytest cases passed (health, root, quote/contact submission persistence, validation errors, listing). Frontend Playwright run validated: title, hero, navbar scroll, 5 service cards, 5 industry cards, footer, quote form submission (success message visible + form cleared), HTML5 native validation blocking empty submit. SMTP is intentionally unconfigured – backend correctly persists lead, returns 200, logs warning (expected behavior, not a bug).

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') – consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan context manager

action_items: Provide real SMTP credentials in /app/backend/.env (SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM) when ready to enable email notifications to ventas@maetornilleria.com.mx
Optional: Replace placeholder COMPANY.phone / addressFull in /app/frontend/src/constants/content.js with real values when available
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes pydantic v2 (ConfigDict) with deprecated @app.on_event – consider lifespan handler for forward compat

list_submissions converts created_at back to datetime AFTER fetching from Mongo (where it was stored as ISO string). Works but storing as native datetime would be cleaner and enable native Mongo sorting on Date type
send_email_notification swallows all exceptions – consider distinguishing auth errors from transient failures for better observability
Frontend QuoteForm posts data with form_type pre-set to 'quote' – correct. No client-side email regex validation beyond HTML5 type=email which is acceptable
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed contact submissions during pytest (one quote, one contact). Safe to leave or purge via Mongo if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a public Spanish B2B landing for MAE Tornillería. Only public endpoints: GET /api/health, GET /api/, POST /api/contact, GET /api/submissions. Frontend single-page (Landing) with anchor sections (#nosotros, #servicios, #industrias, #cotizar). Quote form posts to /api/contact with form_type='quote'. SMTP intentionally empty – do NOT mark missing email send as a bug.
